scope: Retrospective exploratory secondary diagnostic, after development and candidate nomination; no preregistration or confirmation claim
method: Hansen-Lunde-Nason sequential Tmax MCS with common circular-block resampling, unchanged project implementation
loss: At each date, mean squared error over the fixed fitted seeds of each recipe; deterministic controls once
primary_endpoint_warning: This secondary loss is not the primary mean of individual-seed RMSEs. No equivalence or practical RMSE-margin inference is claimed.
uncertainty_scope: Calendar-only conditional on this fixed fitted cohort. No seed-population or selected-design uncertainty.
decision_scope: Both block-length sensitivity runs reported. No choice by favorable result; membership does not demonstrate equivalence, adequacy or R3.
pvalue_reporting: Excluded models have actual sequential-max adjusted finite-bootstrap p. Surviving models have no calculated individual membership p: report null and the explicit survival bound, never fill p=1.

source_reference.license_scope: Existing project source preserved byte for byte; no new global license or third-party data permission granted.

limits: Only 55 exposed daily dates; block14 has fewer than four nominal block lengths in the observed calendar
Weak dependence and temporal stability needed by the block bootstrap remain unverified; neither calibration nor coverage is certified by these data
Not a third distinct procedure for the primary pairwise family; outside Holm128 residual diagnostics and outside confirmation
Five fitted seeds remain fixed; neither seeds nor model recipes are new independent datasets
No training/selection prediction CSVs or interval distributions are reconstructed
